parsed.name: R&S HMP4040四通道直流电源
parsed.name_en: R&S HMP4040 Four-Channel DC Power Supply
parsed.description: 一款可编程四通道台式直流电源，用于在实验中为电路、传感器或测试模块提供稳定电压与限流输出，并读取各通道的电压、电流和保护状态。
parsed.description_en: A programmable four-channel bench DC power supply used in laboratories to provide stable voltage and current-limited outputs for circuits, sensors, or test modules, while monitoring channel voltage, current, and protection status.
